paragraphs.text: Paratrooper is an acorn class , used for soldiers that are trained to attack or land in combat areas by parachuting from airplanes.

Paratrooper debuted as a creature type in Unhinged on Orcish Paratroopers and has yet to appear in any other set. Orcs from the Un-iverse have been seen to have paratroopers though they were seen to be connected to an anvil instead of a parachute. Paratroopers were also seen during the Brothers' War who fought against Dragon Engines though they use the soldier type in the normal multiverse .
